act_brief.state_offer: State the base offer (AMOUNT_TO_SAY) and ask what the candidate thinks. Do not say it is negotiable or final.
act_brief.confirm_number: The candidate named a number that fits what you planned. Say you can offer that amount (AMOUNT_TO_SAY) and ask if they want to go ahead.
act_brief.ask_number: Ask the candidate what number they have in mind. Say no number yourself.
act_brief.press_number: You still need a number. Ask for it again, politely but clearly. Say no number yourself.
act_brief.ask_figure: You did not catch a figure. Ask what number they mean.
act_brief.object: Voice ONE concern (OBJECTION_IDEA) about what the candidate asked. Do not give anything yet and do not name a new offer.
act_brief.concede: You have heard the candidate's reasons. Move the base to AMOUNT_TO_SAY, a small step, and say it is a real move. Do not say it is final.
act_brief.concede_final: Move the base to AMOUNT_TO_SAY and say clearly that this is as far as base goes.
act_brief.hold: You need something new before you can move. Keep the current base (AMOUNT_TO_SAY) and say what you need. Do not name a new number.
act_brief.hold_none: You need to understand more. Ask the candidate to tell you more about what is behind their ask. Name no amount.
act_brief.say_final: Say plainly that base stays at AMOUNT_TO_SAY and cannot move any further.
act_brief.hold_final: Base stays at AMOUNT_TO_SAY and is final. Say it kindly and do not argue again.
act_brief.hold_confirm: The candidate asked for less than or equal to your current offer. Happily confirm AMOUNT_TO_SAY and ask if they want to go ahead.
act_brief.give_lever: Offer the extra item in LEVER_TO_SAY (not base pay). Say it briefly.
act_brief.lever_object: The candidate asked for something outside the base. Say it is not standard and ask why it matters to them. Offer nothing yet.
act_brief.lever_unavailable: Say you cannot offer that one.
act_brief.lever_deferred: Say base comes first, then the rest of the package.
act_brief.lever_repeat: Say that one is already on the table.
act_brief.equity: Say equity is set by level and is not part of this conversation.
act_brief.agree_written: Say you will put whatever is agreed in writing.
act_brief.ask_date: The candidate wants time. Ask for the exact day they can answer by.
act_brief.wait_ack: The candidate is thinking. Say to take a moment.
act_brief.take_lower: The candidate named a number lower than you expected. Say it is closer to what you had in mind, without celebrating.
act_brief.share_range: Share the posted range given in the amounts and ask where they see themselves.
act_brief.deflect_range: You cannot share internal ranges. Ask for their number instead.
act_brief.answer_other: Answer briefly and steer back to the candidate's number or ask.
act_brief.come_back: You are back from checking. Say what you can do now (AMOUNT_TO_SAY or LEVER_TO_SAY, or that nothing changed).
act_brief.step_up_ask_criteria: Ask what goals or results they would want to have shown by then.

offer.example: Fair point. Last year I cut onboarding drop-off by a third, so 60,000 still feels right.

offer.title: If base is stuck, trade
offer.rule: Ask for a step-up after probation, a sign-on bonus or an earlier review.
offer.example: If 55,500 is the limit today, could we agree on 60,000 after the three-month probation?

offer.title: Close it in writing
offer.rule: Amount, date and goals, in the offer letter. A promise said aloud is not a deal.
offer.example: Great. Could you put the 60,000 at three months and the goals in the offer?

raise.title: Collect results since your last raise
raise.rule: Two or three results with a number: what you did and what changed for the team.
raise.example: Since my last raise I led the migration and cut support tickets by a third.

raise.title: Open with the number and two results
raise.rule: Say the raise you want and why, in the first minute.
raise.example: I'd like to discuss a raise to 72,000. Here's what changed this year: the migration and the new onboarding.

raise.title: Turn "not now" into a date and criteria
raise.rule: If the answer is "not now", ask when, and what you need to show by then.
raise.example: I understand. Could we agree on June, and what I'd need to show by then?

raise.title: Trade: a part now, a title or a dated raise
raise.rule: If the full raise is not possible, ask for part of it now, a title, or the rest on a date.
raise.example: Could we do 68,000 now and 72,000 in June if I hit those two goals?

raise.title: Get it in writing
raise.rule: The amount, the date and the goals, in an email after the talk.
raise.example: Thanks. Could you send me that in an email, so we're aligned?
